dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple closed-loop 'O' structures with irregular, high-contrast borders are visible across the mid-lateral section. The gradient transition from dark-pigmented perimeters to light-tan interiors is abrupt, featuring jagged, non-uniform edge geometry.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of asymmetrical, high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated near the flipper base and along the ventral-lateral transition. These clusters exhibit solid core intensity without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest lateral annuli form a scalene triangle. Spatial relationships between the primary annuli and the clusters near the flipper insertion form a distinct non-linear polygon.
